decisions.reason: The compact rotating-skip dumper was launched only in 2023 and has its own page, so it fits the firm's announced construction-machinery direction, and weak early results can still be blamed on the temporary construction downturn, which favours persisting.

The articulated dumper represents substantial engineering and tooling investment that management must justify, and its visible presentation and the cyclical slump in construction make it likely the firm stays the course.

The underground mine rescue vehicle is a niche product with long project cycles, so slow initial orders can plausibly be attributed to temporary causes, and the heavy development cost and public commitment argue for keeping it.
The compact telescopic loader is only one year on the market and is promoted on its own page, so sunk costs and the need to justify the launch decision make retention most likely.
